title: Conductor: failure and recovery
description: A coding agent makes changes. The harness decides whether they land.
caption: Controlled fault injection; live GPT-6.1 Sol repairs. This is a captioned replay of actual event receipts.

title: 01  Assign a release-rule task
description: A shop package needs an approval for its current revision before release.
caption: Fixed starting files. The worker edits; Conductor owns the gate and merge.

title: 02  Introduce a bad change
description: For this demonstration, a scripted worker approves every revision.
caption: The fault is deliberate. It is excluded from the model benchmark.

title: 03  The gate rejects it
description: The visible check catches an old approval being accepted for a new revision.
caption: Conductor sends the failing check and current diff to a live model. Main has not advanced.

title: 04  Verify, then merge
description: The repair passes the gate and all six independent checks for this fixture.
caption: Conductor verifies the merged result before advancing main. The repair was made by the live model.

title: 05  Interrupt another worker
description: A real subprocess saves a partial material-reservation edit. We send SIGTERM.
caption: The improved interruption path persists the failure reason and diff before cleaning the worktree.

title: 06  Recover in a fresh process
description: A new process reads the same saved diff and failure record. A live model completes the task.
caption: The saved and loaded diff hashes match. The recovered change passes all six fixture checks and merges.

title: 07  Break main deliberately
description: A red-main check creates a durable stop and a local alert receipt.
caption: No external notification is delivered in this test. That delivery failure is recorded; the stop still works.

title: 08  Restart cannot bypass the stop
description: A new process still sees the incident. Recovery while the gate is red is rejected.
caption: The operator restores the prior verified commit. Conductor must run the gate again before clearing the stop.

title: 09  Verify recovery
description: Fresh verification passes at an unchanged main commit. The durable stop is cleared.
caption: Real Git operations, real gate commands, persisted receipts. Small fixtures demonstrate the recovery mechanism; no shop pilot is claimed.
